Definition: Integration of farmer registries, agricultural input vouchers, land registrations, extension services data
Comments: NCRA and Ministry of Agriculture (MAFS) meeting in May 2025 to integrate National Digital Farmer Registry with NIN system. Food Systems Resilience Project (FSRP) involved. Each farmer's record to be authenticated using NIN, eliminating duplications. Integration planned and implementation underway.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Corroborated: two independent outlets (Calabash Newspaper, SierraLoaded, both 19-20 May 2025) report the same NCRA-MAFS meeting to link the Digital Farmer Registry to the NIN system, and a June 2026 SierraLoaded report confirms MAFS now operates a geo-tagged Farmers Registry with IVR/e-voucher services, but does not confirm NIN authentication is complete. Evidence still supports "Under development" (3); score confirmed, not upgraded.

Definition: Integration of tax administration and revenue collection systems data into the exchange platform
Comments: Integrated Tax Administration System (ITAS) of the National Revenue Authority and Customs ASYCUDA system exist. The GSB interoperability scope explicitly includes ITAS. A PFM interoperability working group established in 2024 to connect these systems. No operational integration between tax and a central data exchange platform currently.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: The Ministry of Finance's own 2025 PFM Reform Progress Report (published June 2026) confirms a PFM Interoperability Roadmap - whose scope explicitly names ITAS - has now been developed, with a Government Service Bus/X-Road pilot planned, and the World Bank TOR confirms interface/API development to link ITAS to the GSB is a standard contracted activity. This is beyond mere "Planned" status, so the score is raised from 2 to 3 (Under development); no evidence yet of live/operational integration, so 4-5 not supported.

Definition: Integration of social assistance programs, grant registries, beneficiary management systems
Comments: National social assistance program shifting to digital payments with mobile phone (35,000 household milestone). World Bank is supporting digital social protection delivery. Emergency cash transfer systems operational. Integration with NIN-based ID being pursued. Partial integration achieved for payments; full registry integration still under development.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed via the World Bank's December 2025 update (35,000-household mobile cash transfer milestone; digital ID/civil registration integration still described as "underway") and NaCSA/Statistics Sierra Leone MoUs (April-May 2026) expanding the SPRINT social registry and data-sharing protocols. This corroborates ongoing but incomplete integration; score confirmed at 3 (Under development), not upgraded, as no source confirms full or majority integration into a central exchange.
